# Learnwise

Learnwise is an AI-powered learning studio for courses, uploaded materials, questions, practice, voice learning, and progress tracking.

## Public pages

- /: Product overview and feature tour
- /faq: Frequently asked questions
- /contact: Contact Learnwise
- /auth/register: Create a learner account

## Product capabilities

- Upload PDFs, notes, audio, and course materials.
- Ask an AI learning companion for explanations and connections.
- Generate quizzes and exercises from learning materials.
- Learn with voice prompts and audio-friendly content.
- Track concepts, activity, progress, and next steps.
- Provide educators with material management and learning analytics.
